title: Why Drinking Too Much Water Can Kill You in 3 Hours (Acute Hyponatremia)

shots.vo: Saaf thanda paani zindagi hai — bina iske insaan kuch din bhi zinda nahi reh sakta.
Par January 2007 mein California ke ek live FM radio station par...
ek ajeeb contest rakha gaya — Hold Your Wee for a Wii, jisme sabse zyada paani peene par gaming console milna tha!
28-saal ki Jennifer Strange ne apne bacchon ke liye sirf 3 ghante mein lagbhag 7 liter paani pee liya.
Ghar lautne ke 5 ghante baad woh behosh ho gayi... aur phir kabhi nahi uthi.
Autopsy mein na koi zeher mila, na koi drug — sirf saaf paani!
Medical science mein is silent killer ko kehte hain — Acute Hyponatremia, yaani Water Intoxication!
Bachpan se hum sunte aaye hain — jitna zyada paani piyoge utna healthy? Yeh adhoora sach jaanleva ho sakta hai!
Samajhne ke liye apne body ke smart filter — Kidneys ko dekho.
Healthy kidneys ek ghante mein maximum sirf 0.8 se 1 liter paani hi filter karke bahar nikal sakti hain.
Jab aap ek saath 2 ya 3 liter paani gatak jaate ho, toh kidneys overflow ho jaati hain — aur paani khoon mein jama hota hai!
Aapke khoon mein Sodium ions ka exact balance hona zaroori hai — 135 se 145 millimoles per liter.
Yahi sodium khoon ka fluid balance sambhalta hai aur nerves ke electric signals chalata hai.
Par jab khoon mein achanak paani ki baadh aati hai, toh sodium ghul kar patla ho jaata hai!
135 se neeche khatra shuru hota hai — aur 120 se neeche aate hi emergency!
Ab yahan physics ka ek kathor niyam kaam karta hai — Osmosis. Paani kam namak se zyada namak ki taraf bhaagta hai!
Nateeja? Khoon ka extra paani cells ke Aquaporin channels cheer kar andar ghusne lagta hai!
Aur aapke laakhon cells paani bharne se gubbare ki tarah phoolne lagte hain!
Haath-pair aur skin ki soft muscles mein phailne ki jagah hoti hai, toh woh sujan jhel leti hain.
Par aapka dimaag band hai 7 millimeter moti thos haddi ke pinjre — Skull ke andar, jahan phailne ki jagah nahi!
Jab brain ke Astrocytes paani sokh kar sujte hain, toh dimaag khud apni hi khopdi ki deewar se kuchalne lagta hai!
Skull ke andar pressure chaar guna badh jaata hai aur khoon ki supply rukne lagti hai.
Shuruat hoti hai tez sir-dard, ulti aur ajeeb confusion se — jo aksar heatstroke samajh liya jaata hai.
Dimaag ko nikalne ka koi raasta nahi milta, toh woh neeche Foramen Magnum ke chhed mein dhasne lagta hai!
Isse Brainstem dab jaata hai — saans aur dhadkan ka switch band, aur insaan coma mein chala jaata hai!
Aur yeh sirf kisi contest mein nahi — marathon runners ke har aath mein se ek finisher mein mild hyponatremia dekha gaya hai!
Kyunki paseene mein paani ke saath namak bhi nikalta hai — upar se sirf sada paani peena sodium ko aur gira deta hai.
6 mahine se chhote bacchon ko toh kabhi alag se sada paani nahi dena chahiye — unki chhoti kidneys ise jhel nahi paati.
Hospital mein doctors turant 3% Hypertonic Saline IV dete hain — jo dimaag se extra paani wapas kheench leta hai!
Khud ko safe rakhne ke sirf 3 simple hydration rules hain.
Pehla: paani ek saath gatakne ke bajaye aaram se piyo — ek ghante mein 800 ml se zyada nahi.
Doosra: kadi dhoop, gym ya running mein paseena aaye, toh paani mein Electrolytes ya ORS zaroor milao.
Teesra: sabse aasaan test — urine bilkul paani jaisa safed nahi, halka pale-straw hona chahiye!
Apni body ke natural Thirst signal par bharosa rakho — woh laakhon saal ke evolution ka meter hai.
Kyunki science mein zeher koi cheez nahi, uski matra hoti hai — saaf paani ki bhi!
Yeh reel apne gym aur runner doston ke saath abhi share karo!
